summary: Enhance your skills with our Commercial Banking Operations Training Course. Gain essential knowledge and practical insights to excel in the banking industry.
lede: Commercial banking operations coordinates account servicing, transaction processing, reconciliation and control checks across daily workflows. For operations officers, branch supervisors, payment analysts and KYC staff, the practical focus is managing these processes and resolving exceptions with consistent documentation. Participants practice mapping workflows, checking onboarding files, reconciling transaction breaks and creating control evidence for review.
audienceIntro: This commercial banking operations training is built for professionals who handle account servicing, payment processing, documentation control, and operational oversight in commercial banks.
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of banking products, account services, or branch operations. Familiarity with transaction processing, internal controls, and common banking documents will help, but no coding is required. Advanced topics are taught at an operational level, with hands-on practice using workflow maps, exception logs, reconciliation templates, and control checklists. A laptop is recommended for digital exercises and template completion.
